## Review checklist
- [ ] CI is green (lint, unit tests on Node 20 and 22, build)
- [ ] New code has unit tests, including the error cases
- [ ] Names are clear and the code is easy to follow
- [ ] The README / help text is updated if a command changed
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or `homework.json` in the commit
